title: Intake / output balance
description: Record each amount consumed, administered or collected. Add a separate entry for each source.
totals_scope: Recorded entries in this form · mL
incomplete: Entries with missing or incomplete volumes: {{count}}. Totals include valid volumes only.
empty: No entries yet. Add an intake or output to begin.
interval_help: For a collected amount, enter its start and end. Leave start empty for a single event.
builder_help: Each entry creates one panel Observation with a coded volume component. Collection details remain in the form.
schema_error: This chart needs its schema repaired before recording measurements.
volume_error: Enter a nonnegative finite volume, or select why it is unavailable.
time_error: Enter a valid measurement time. Collection start must not be after the end.
kind_error: Select an available source and measurement.
configuration_error: Enable repeating entries and panel observations in the form editor.
history_scope: Load saved volume observations. These totals exclude the entries currently being edited.
history_error: Could not load all recorded I/O. Retry to calculate totals.
history_empty: No recorded volume components found for this chart date.
history_limits: Recorded volumes only. Times shown are recording times. Form corrections may not update observation statuses; review the entries before using these totals.
history_skipped: Excluded components with invalid volumes or unsupported units: {{count}}.
history_tab_scope: Saved volume observations for the selected encounter.
history_unavailable: Recorded I/O is unavailable for this encounter.
reporting_scope: 08:00–08:00 next day · Local time · Grouped by recording time
hourly_scope: Recorded volume in mL. Hover or focus an hour for amounts; empty hours have no recorded entries.
shift_scope: Volumes in mL. A dash means no entries were recorded in that shift.
history_undated: Some entries have no valid recording time. They are included in the encounter balance but excluded from the daily chart.
